title: 16_anchor (Trinity Anchor)
description: Trinity Anchor artifact for Step 16. Declares the full scope of a multi-milestone implementation, tracks which milestones own which FRs, and is the cross-milestone drift-detection surface. Does NOT carry a per-FR checklist — that detail lives in each 16a milestone plan. Does NOT carry execution or review sections — those are milestone-plan concerns.

artifact_role.description: Identifies this artifact as the Trinity Anchor. Must always be the string 'anchor'.

plan.description: Anchor-level plan: scope declaration, accumulated ambiguities, drift monitoring schedule, and milestone ownership registry.

summary.description: High-level scope summary for the full multi-milestone implementation.

functional_summary.description: 1-3 sentences describing the full implementation scope: the capability delivered, primary actors, and key constraints across all milestones.

scope_in.description: Items explicitly included across all milestones. Each string should name a concrete capability, endpoint, or system boundary. At least one entry is required so cross-milestone drift detection has a non-empty comparison surface.

items.description: A concrete scope item included in this implementation.

scope_out.description: Items explicitly excluded from all milestones. A milestone whose scope_in contains one of these values is in contradiction with the anchor. May be empty on a fresh anchor with no exclusions.

items.description: A concrete scope item excluded from this implementation.

ambiguities.description: Accumulated unresolved decisions and ambiguities across all Trinity cycles. Reuses the shared crossCycleAmbiguityItem shape. An empty array on a fresh anchor is valid.

items.description: A cross-milestone ambiguity or unresolved architectural decision.

drift.description: Drift monitoring log. Records the drift checks that have been run across milestone cycles. An empty checks array is valid on a fresh anchor.

items.description: Description of a drift check performed or scheduled. Must be a meaningful prose entry containing at least two words. Example: 'Verified ms-auth scope_in does not overlap anchor scope_out (2026-04-10)'.

checks.description: Drift checks performed or planned across milestone cycles. Each string documents what was checked and when.

milestone_index.description: Registry of all milestones covered by this anchor. Each entry declares which FRs/APIs a milestone owns and the checklist ID namespace it uses. An empty array is valid on a fresh anchor before any milestone plans are created.

items.description: A milestone entry in the anchor index.

milestone_id.description: Kebab-case ID matching the milestone_id in 14_roadmap.json.

context_path.description: Relative path to this milestone's 16a plan. Canonical form: 'impl_context/ms_auth_plan.json' (relative to spec/). The 'spec/' prefix form is accepted for repo-root-relative conventions. Must point at a file inside impl_context/ with a lowercase/underscore/digit filename ending in .json.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this milestone, reusing the shared milestoneStatus atom (same enum as 14_roadmap.json). Values: 'pending', 'in_progress', 'done', 'deferred'. Only 'done' milestones are exempt from FR ownership conflict detection.

items.description: An FR or API ID owned by this milestone. Must start with 'fr-' or 'api-'.

fr_refs.description: FR and API IDs owned by this milestone. Duplicates within the array are a schema error. Two non-done milestones claiming the same ID is a scope conflict. Pattern restricts entries to fr-* or api-* IDs.

checklist_id_prefix.description: SCREAMING_SNAKE prefix namespace for checklist IDs in this milestone's 16a plan (e.g., 'AUTH', 'PAYMENT', 'USER_MGMT'). Must be unique across milestone_index entries to prevent cross-milestone ID collisions.

summary.description: One-line status summary for this milestone. Example: 'Auth token issuance — 3/5 checklist items verified, CI green'.

allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).
